concepts.name: State encoder (proprioception token)
concepts.summary: A vision-language model has no input path for proprioception: roughly eight continuous numbers giving joint angles and gripper state. They cannot be tokenised, because a tokeniser maps symbols to indices and a joint angle is not a symbol. A small MLP projects the state vector to the model's token width, state (8,) → (d_model,), after which it is structurally an ordinary token. Concatenated into the sequence, self-attention fuses it with vision and language at no extra design cost. Normalise the state per dimension before projecting.

concepts.name: Action head families
concepts.summary: The three ways to turn a VLM's hidden states into continuous robot commands. DISCRETE TOKENS bin each joint's range and predict bin indices with the existing language head (RT-2, OpenVLA), multimodal, but binning loses precision and autoregressive decoding is slow. MLP REGRESSION projects the hidden state to a continuous action, fast and continuous, but it collapses multiple valid actions to their mean. A FLOW OR DIFFUSION HEAD is a small generative network conditioned on the hidden state (π0), multimodal and continuous at the cost of several forward passes. Assembly in all three cases: [image patches][text tokens][state token] → transformer → hidden states → head.
